desc: A majestic small whale-shaped spirit: round pale lavender body, black void face with two small white eyes, gold crystal crown, gold fin bands, grandest design. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
